---
title: v2.2.4 — Structured Release Notes and Reliable Publication
---

## Overview

This release prepares version-specific titles and structured notes before tagging, validates their sources during pull request checks, and makes unpublished release retries safe.

## Highlights

- Resolve a release title and description from committed metadata, explicit merged pull request declarations, or a single related pull request; carry the validated content through tag creation and draft verification.
- Grant the release preparation job the GitHub permission needed to generate notes, and check content sources in pull request CI against the previous published release with the proposed pull request included.
- Allow retries before publication only for the original commit and matching tag or draft. Select artifacts from their producing jobs so a retry can reuse successful artifacts from an earlier attempt.
